name: Equity Scholarships Scheme University of Newcastle (ESSUN)
summary: Scholarship for University of Newcastle undergraduates on Centrelink means-tested income support.
key: Up to $8,000 for one academic year of study.
who: Enrolled in an undergraduate program (including honours and non-FEE-FREE Uni Ready diplomas)
Receiving a Centrelink means-tested income support payment
Not holding another University of Newcastle scholarship that year
how: Apply through the online portal (PDF uploads only); apply early as offers can be made at any time
catches: Part-time students receive $1,750 per eligible study period

source.label: University of Newcastle: Equity Scholarships Scheme (ESSUN)

evidence.quote: The scholarship provides a benefit of up to $8,000 for one academic year of study and will be paid as:
Be experiencing financial challenges, demonstrated through receipt of a centrelink means-tested income support payment
